issues: The 'Made with Emergent' preview badge in the bottom-right corner overlaps the data-testid='send-message-btn'. Pointer-events on the badge intercept clicks on the send button, blocking normal Playwright .click() (and may affect users in preview env who click the bottom-right edge). Workarounds: Enter keypress (which the UI already supports) or force=True click. Enter-to-send is documented behavior so this is a preview-env artifact, not a code defect — but worth flagging because the same overlap affects the bottom-nav 'Messages' and 'Profile' tabs on the worker mobile layout (390x844).

If you want to be extra safe, give #emergent-badge `pointer-events: none` on the parent <a> OR raise z-index on the composer/footer above the badge.
